# NP Coaches (New Punjab Coaches Ltd)

> West London coach hire operator running charter, scheduled inter-city, and home-to-school coach services. Founded 1999. Depot in Iver, Buckinghamshire (SL0 9QZ). Fleet of 15+ Euro 6 ULEZ-compliant coaches ranging from 19 to 98 seats. Family-run business now operated by founder's sons Jujhaar Singh Brainch (CEO) and Mandeep Singh Brainch (Compliance & Operations Manager).

## About

- [About NP Coaches](https://np-coaches.co.uk/about-us/): Company history, leadership, accreditations.
- [Contact](https://np-coaches.co.uk/contact-us/): Address, phone, email, depot map.
- [routeone industry feature, March 2025](https://www.route-one.net/features/np-coaches-strong-investment-delivering-results-for-iver-business/): Independent industry coverage.

## Services

- [Charter coach hire and UK tours](https://np-coaches.co.uk/uk-tours/): Private hire for groups, day tours, corporate events, weddings, sports teams, and tour operators. Coverage UK-wide from West London depot.
- [Home-to-school transport](https://np-coaches.co.uk/home-to-school/): Daily routes to Pioneer Secondary Academy (Burnham and Langley campuses) and Herschel Grammar School in Slough. ShuttleID tracking, QR code boarding, GoCardless billing.
- [Daily Express scheduled coach service](https://np-coaches.co.uk/daily-express-service/): Daily AM and PM services between London (Southall, Slough) and Coventry, Birmingham, Wolverhampton. London–Leicester service runs Fri–Mon only.

## Routes

- [Wolverhampton to London](https://np-coaches.co.uk/wolverhampton-to-london/)
- [London to Leicester](https://np-coaches.co.uk/london-to-leicester/)
- [Leicester to London](https://np-coaches.co.uk/leicester-to-london/)

## Fleet

- [19 seat mini coaches](https://np-coaches.co.uk/19-seat-coaches/): Reclining leather seats, air-con, USB charging, DVD, luggage hold.
- [35 seat midi coaches](https://np-coaches.co.uk/35-seat-coaches/): Adds seat-back tables, on-board fridge, PA system.
- [53 seat executive coaches](https://np-coaches.co.uk/53-seat-coaches/): Full executive spec, ideal for groups of 40–53.
- [72 seat coaches](https://np-coaches.co.uk/76-seat-coaches/): Large group capacity with executive amenities.
- [86 seat double deckers](https://np-coaches.co.uk/86-seat-coaches/): Forward and back-facing seating.
- [98 seat double deckers](https://np-coaches.co.uk/98-seat-coaches/): Maximum capacity, back-facing seating throughout.

## Service area

London (West London, Southall, Heathrow), Buckinghamshire (Iver, Slough, Burnham, Langley, Beaconsfield, Uxbridge), Berkshire (Reading, Maidenhead, Windsor), and UK-wide for charter work.

## Accreditations

ULEZ-compliant Euro 6 fleet, DBS-checked drivers, CPT member, full UK PSV operator licence. See `/downloads/` for the current annual Compliance Pack.
